What we have actually learned about the emulator

A figure-first account of the 85604 data, representation ladder, deterministic and stochastic one-step failures, the localized covariance defect, and the ECRD repair now running on Rusty.

01 · Start here

The one-minute answer

  • The data are not incoherent. Fast toroidal translation is superposed on slower profile and amplitude drift.
  • Compression is no longer the main blocker. A matched C5P DCAE-L10 passes the complete O1 reconstruction gate at all three seeds.
  • The failure occurs in one saved step. H1/H2 and B2–B5 improve ordinary field scores but fail realization-level spectra and nonlinear transport.
  • B5 is the best stochastic baseline so far. It improves fair CRPS, mean error, and expected power, but its covariance is organized incorrectly.
  • ECRD is the controlled repair. All four arms and three seeds trained; the full M32 gate is still running.

02 · Data and time

Slow drift plus fast coherent motion

The saved cadence is 3.131905 µs. The simulated wedge is one fifth of the torus, so stored Fourier index k corresponds to physical toroidal mode n=5k.

03 · Representation

More latent capacity was not automatically better

The historical f8/z44 comparison was not a controlled capacity ablation. It nevertheless showed exactly why pixel error cannot stand in for transport fidelity.

Field and spectral reconstruction

f8 has lower five-field RMSE and preserves the dominant n=20–25 band. z44 retains some higher modes but is not uniformly better.

Transport reconstruction

Net separatrix transport can look excellent while local signed face contributions remain wrong. Both scales must be checked.

04 · One-step models

Good marginal forecasts still miss the realized physics

The fault appears before autoregressive feedback: these are teacher-forced one-step tests on all 126 chronological validation targets.

05 · Physics figures

Flux, modes, phase, and spatial covariance

These are the physical diagnostics behind the gate—not only aggregate ML scores. The transport trace below is an O1 codec reconstruction. The B5 panels are one-step forecasts. An autonomous Paper 0 rollout is intentionally absent because O4 has not been authorized.

06 · The decisive B5 finding

Local variance is present; coherent transport variance is not

B5 is not simply too narrow everywhere. It is close to calibrated for pooled local face-flux contributions and badly underdispersed after those same contributions are integrated.

07 · Cause localization

The transition is conditional and not exactly equivariant

Phase 3.5 rejects the broad claim that stochastic emulation is impossible. It rejects only one fixed, global, condition-independent linear residual law.

08 · What is running

ECRD tests the mechanisms implicated by the evidence

The ladder adds deep raw-field conditioning, exact toroidal handling in the generator, a symmetrized H1 parent plus mean correction, joint multiscale noise, and then the smallest history extension.

Next decision: the frozen seven-family reducer checks fair CRPS, spectral retention, Ne–phi dependence, spatial transport covariance, integrated spread without local overdispersion, and multi-seed robustness. Only a passing arm may open one evaluation on 85606.

09 · Scientific boundary

What we can and cannot say

Supported

  • There is coherent toroidal motion and slow chronological drift.
  • The matched codec can preserve the evaluated representation.
  • Low field error and mean cross-phase do not guarantee transport-faithful joint forecasts.
  • B5's dominant defect is covariance organization, not zero spread.

Not supported

  • No model has yet passed the complete Paper 0 forecast gate.
  • No autonomous rollout has been accepted.
  • 85606 generalization remains unknown.
  • ETKF/EnKF, diagnostic ranking, and steering remain unauthorized.
